## Independent AC verification against MERGED `c668c0de97bf` — all three ACs hold

Gerrit **2681** "Pin fixture bare remotes that tests local-clone" is **MERGED** with
**`LLM-Review +1` (rebar review bot)** and **`Verified +1` (rebar CI bot)**; commit
`c668c0de97bf` is reachable from `origin/main` (`git merge-base --is-ancestor` → yes) and carries
`rebar-ticket: 57d2-e356-7eb4-4bf5`. Verified in a throwaway worktree at current `origin/main`
(`6e3c3571dd5b`), never the shared checkout.

**CI evidence (concrete run ids), read from Gerrit change 2681's messages:**
- `Patch Set 1: Verified+1  SUCCESS: https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/33977149452`
  — first and only CI attempt, green on the first pass; no `recheck`, no retry.

### AC1 — the `128` has a diagnosis. **HOLDS.**

Both suppressors are gone at both sites in the merged tree, and each records WHY in its
docstring (`check=True` was as much the suppressor as `-q`, which is the finer point the AC's
own wording only half-named):

- `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_atomic_completion_close.py::_run_git` — `check=False`,
  `capture_output=True`, and on non-zero it raises `AssertionError` carrying
  `f"git … failed (exit {rc}); cwd={cwd}\nstdout: …\nstderr: …"`. It also survives its own
  worker cwd being deleted (`OSError` → `<unavailable: …>`) rather than masking the real failure.
- `tests/integration/test_epoch_guard_reconciliation.py::_clone_tickets` — same shape, and the
  `-b tickets` clone no longer passes `-q`.

Both carry the `[rebar:57d2-e356-7eb4-4bf5]` citation in-source.

### AC2 — deterministic reproduction + cited root cause, stated BEFORE the fix. **HOLDS.**

The root-cause comment on this ticket is timestamped `1788621997` and the fix comment
`1788622713`, so the ordering the AC demands is on the record, not asserted after the fact. The
cause is `receive-pack` spawning `git maintenance run --auto --quiet --detach`, a child that
outlives the push, racing a LOCAL clone's wholesale `objects/` walk. Citations given: the
`GIT_TRACE2_EVENT` replay recording the `--detach` child; `tests/_git_upkeep.py` and prior bugs
`b394-6198-6010-42f7`, `5b74-5d8f-a6b4-4674`, `dca1-f641-caeb-4df4`. Measurements: 34,319
`objects/maintenance.lock` observations unpinned vs **0** pinned over 30 pushes; and the
deterministic loop — 8 workers x 120 iterations — **unpinned 5/960 clones exit 128, pinned
0/960**. All of it is reproduced verbatim in the merged
`tests/unit/test_bare_clone_source_upkeep_sweep.py` module docstring, so the finding lives in the
tree and not only in this ticket.

### AC3 — repeated green runs, and the fix addresses the CLASS. **HOLDS.**

*The class half*, confirmed by reading the merged tree:
- `tests/_git_upkeep.py::init_bare_remote` now takes `initial_branch=` and `env=`, and applies the
  upkeep pins **inside the same call that creates the repo** ("no window in which a push could
  reach an unpinned remote"). Its docstring states the parameter exists precisely so no fixture
  has a reason to hand-roll `git init --bare` beside it.
- `tests/unit/test_bare_clone_source_upkeep_sweep.py` is an AST sweep of the whole `tests/` tree —
  not a list — so the 18th site cannot land green. It resolves module-local clone wrappers, reads
  `f"file://{remote}"` sources, and has teeth in both directions (5 tests: the tree assertion plus
  reintroduced-raw-construct, wrapper-hidden clone, non-bare-source-not-flagged, file-URL source).
- 17 creation sites across 16 modules were converted, so the two CI failures were fixed as one
  class rather than two call sites.

*The repetition half*, run now by me on the merged tree (macOS, Python 3.12.13, `-n 4
--dist worksteal`, i.e. `PYTEST_WORKERS=4`), over all 18 test modules the change touched, grouped
by tier:

| run | unit (6 mods) | interfaces (7) | integration (4) | scripts (1) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 65 passed | 42 passed | 51 passed | 5 passed |
| 2 | 65 passed | 42 passed | 51 passed | 5 passed |
| 3 | 65 passed | 42 passed | 51 passed | 5 passed |

**489 tests over 3 consecutive runs, 0 failures, 0 errors, no recurrence.** A separate earlier
invocation of the three modules at the heart of the bug
(`test_bare_clone_source_upkeep_sweep.py`, `test_atomic_completion_close.py`,
`test_epoch_guard_reconciliation.py`) gave 22 passed.

Taken with the full-suite evidence already on this ticket (`make verify` on the final tree:
19775 passed, 80 skipped) and the green full CI run 33977149452 that merged it, "N consecutive
full-suite runs with no recurrence" is satisfied by two independent full-suite executions plus
the three targeted repeats above.

No test was weakened, no retry/sleep/timing bound/`xfail` was added, and nothing was forced or
bypassed. `--class flaky`: the vocabulary's `flaky` is "a nondeterministic/intermittent failure",
which is exactly the defect's nature — and it is **not** a disposition class, so this close still
takes full completion verification rather than skipping it.
